capability.name: Motor contable segmentado configurable
intents: asociar segmentos contables a dimensiones de negocio
validar bodega sucursal tercero como segmentos
comparar modelo contable tipo Epicor SAP Oracle Odoo Dynamics

restrictions: DisplayCode cannot become the only persisted accounting identity
NaturalAccount and typed segments must remain separate and queryable
segment masks must be configured and effective-dated by Control Plane
branch, warehouse, cost center, party and reserved segments require explicit semantic owner and source rule
Inventory, AP, AR and POS provide operational facts but do not post Ledger directly
historical DisplayCode semantics cannot change retroactively without migration or backfill CAPA
document splitting must be evaluated before promising balances by warehouse or any segment
BFF and frontend may render DisplayCode but cannot own mask assembly truth
no customer, country, branch, warehouse, account, party or mask hardcoding

deterministic: parse segmented account examples into candidate typed segments
separate natural account from branch warehouse party reserved and future segments
produce CAPA analysis without mutating code when evidence is sufficient
poDecision: whether warehouse is accounting segment operational dimension or both
whether party is segment or subledger reference
default policies by tenant plan or country pack
architectHandoff: segmented chart of accounts semantic model
reviewerGate: no hardcoded mask or customer logic
operational domains do not post Ledger directly
period close and posted history protections remain intact
tenant isolation and BFF boundary hold
forbiddenWithoutApproval: changing account maps or natural account catalog

retrieval.provenance: Accounting segmentation capability added for CAPA Governance v10 on 2026-09-07 to formalize the original UBP/Epicor-style segmented chart of accounts intent as governed policy rather than free-form account-code interpretation. This manifest routes analysis; it does not approve implementation.
